analysis.question: Does Native Build Pro demonstrate capability for long-horizon multi-iteration projects?
limitations: ~15% overhead for process artifacts vs Build Lite baseline
No automated memory quality enforcement (policies exist but manual)
No external validation — trial was harness-internal
Single product type (CRUD-heavy team platform) — generalizability unknown
conditions: Context packets MUST be generated at each iteration boundary
Memory MUST be updated at each iteration close
Agent lifecycle registry MUST be audited for orphans
Write scope map MUST be enforced to prevent collisions
Diagnostic gate MUST run before declaring iteration complete
evidence: 3 iterations completed with full feature delivery each
Memory maintained coherently across all iterations (8 files, 3 update cycles)
Context packets generated at each iteration boundary (10 total)
Agent lifecycle tracked without leaks (3 agents, 0 orphans)
Diagnostic gate caught integration issues (12 checks)
analysis.recommendation: Native Build Pro is viable for long-horizon projects IF context packets are REQUIRED (not optional) and agent lifecycle registry is enforced.
